author: Praxis V
title: Diagnostics: σ_kd distributions — FWPCA-only at δ∈{0.10,0.12} (kd=22, k=50)
abstract: Analysis-only test. Runs FWPCA-only twice on Human Heart with δ=0.10 and δ=0.12 (kd=22, k=50), then computes kd-th neighbor distance (σ_kd) distributions from the final distance graphs. Reports global and per-batch summaries (median, mean, CV, Gini) for both deltas.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import scipy.sparse as sp
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from fwpca_only_utils import run_fwpca_only

def _kd_stat_from_distances(D: sp.csr_matrix, kd: int) -> np.ndarray:
    if not sp.isspmatrix_csr(D):
        D = D.tocsr()
    n = D.shape[0]
    sigma = np.full(n, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    idx_ptr = D.indptr
    data = D.data
    for i in range(n):
        start, end = idx_ptr[i], idx_ptr[i+1]
        row = data[start:end]
        if row.size >= kd:
            kth = np.partition(row, kd-1)[kd-1]
            sigma[i] = float(kth)
    return sigma

def _gini(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    if x.size == 0:
        return np.nan
    x = np.abs(x)
    if np.allclose(x.sum(), 0):
        return 0.0
    x.sort()
    n = x.size
    cumx = np.cumsum(x)
    return (n + 1 - 2 * np.sum(cumx) / cumx[-1]) / n

def _summaries(sigma: np.ndarray, batches: np.ndarray, label: str):
    mask = np.isfinite(sigma)
    s = sigma[mask]
    out = {
        "label": label,
        "n": int(s.size),
        "median": float(np.median(s)) if s.size else np.nan,
        "mean": float(np.mean(s)) if s.size else np.nan,
        "std": float(np.std(s, ddof=1)) if s.size > 1 else np.nan,
        "cv": float(np.std(s, ddof=1) / np.mean(s)) if s.size > 1 and np.mean(s) > 0 else np.nan,
        "gini": float(_gini(s)),
    }
    per_batch = {}
    for b in np.unique(batches):
        mb = mask & (batches == b)
        sb = sigma[mb]
        sb = sb[np.isfinite(sb)]
        per_batch[str(b)] = float(np.median(sb)) if sb.size else np.nan
    out["per_batch_median"] = per_batch
    return out

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    kdensity = 22
    k_total = 50
    batches = np.asarray(adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').values)

    # FWPCA-only at δ=0.10
    ad_d010 = adata.copy()
    ad_d010 = run_fwpca_only(
        ad_d010,
        alpha_g=0.50,
        kdensity=kdensity,
        k_total=k_total,
        delta=0.10,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0,
        pbve_temper=None
    )
    D010 = ad_d010.obsp.get('distances', None)

    # FWPCA-only at δ=0.12
    ad_d012 = adata.copy()
    ad_d012 = run_fwpca_only(
        ad_d012,
        alpha_g=0.50,
        kdensity=kdensity,
        k_total=k_total,
        delta=0.12,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0,
        pbve_temper=None
    )
    D012 = ad_d012.obsp.get('distances', None)

    results = {}
    if D010 is not None:
        sig010 = _kd_stat_from_distances(D010, kdensity)
        results["fwpca_d010"] = _summaries(sig010, batches, "fwpca_d010")
    else:
        results["fwpca_d010"] = {"label": "fwpca_d010", "error": "no_distances"}

    if D012 is not None:
        sig012 = _kd_stat_from_distances(D012, kdensity)
        results["fwpca_d012"] = _summaries(sig012, batches, "fwpca_d012")
    else:
        results["fwpca_d012"] = {"label": "fwpca_d012", "error": "no_distances"}

    # Contrast summary: relative change of median and dispersion
    if "fwpca_d010" in results and "fwpca_d012" in results and "median" in results["fwpca_d010"] and "median" in results["fwpca_d012"]:
        m010 = results["fwpca_d010"]["median"]
        m012 = results["fwpca_d012"]["median"]
        cv010 = results["fwpca_d010"]["cv"]
        cv012 = results["fwpca_d012"]["cv"]
        results["diff"] = {
            "median_ratio_d012_over_d010": (m012 / m010) if (m010 and np.isfinite(m010) and np.isfinite(m012)) else np.nan,
            "cv_delta": (cv012 - cv010) if (cv010 is not None and cv012 is not None) else np.nan
        }

    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return "σ_kd diagnostics completed (FWPCA-only)"
